parameters.query: =SELECT count(*) as total_assessments, count(CASE WHEN risk_level='High' THEN 1 END) as high_risk_count, count(CASE WHEN risk_level='Moderate' THEN 1 END) as moderate_risk_count, count(CASE WHEN risk_level='Low' THEN 1 END) as low_risk_count, count(CASE WHEN needs_human_review = true THEN 1 END) as pending_review_count FROM phq9_assessments WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 HOURS';
